subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open conflicting fork PR before allowing a new fix lane for gateway-lock doctor coverage?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but an open fork PR still uses closing syntax and carries the old unmerged implementation, so automation should not create duplicate work until branch ownership is chosen.

options.title: Replace the stale fork branch
options.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR to implement gateway-lock doctor coverage against current main.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork work
options.body: A maintainer can manually port the useful fork changes onto current main, keep contributor credit, and close the fork after replacement exists.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Leave this issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase and add current proof before any new fix lane starts.

recommendation.title: Replace the stale fork branch
recommendation.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR to implement gateway-lock doctor coverage against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the doctor health-check contract and session-lock diagnostic surface where this fix should likely be wired.
